info.title: MaaS Administration PoC API
info.description: Cluster inventory, AI Grid enrollment and provisioning state use Git ManagedCluster CRs by default, or the ACM Hub when configured. Deployment locations come from Ready, provisioned AI Grid members. Tenants, models and subscriptions remain Git-backed. No namespace fields appear in public payloads.

get.summary: List all ACM Hub ManagedClusters and AI Grid membership
get.description: Reads ManagedCluster CRs from Git when no ACM Hub settings are supplied; otherwise reads the configured live Hub and follows every list page. Availability and provisioning are separate from AI Grid membership.

200.description: Cluster summaries; no managed clusters returns []

403.description: Backend credentials lack ManagedCluster RBAC permissions

404.description: ManagedCluster or ACM API not found

503.description: Hub configuration, connection, response, or timeout failure

patch.summary: Add a ManagedCluster to AI Grid
patch.description: Sets metadata.labels["ai-grid/enabled"] to "true", preserving other labels. In file mode it updates the stored ManagedCluster CR; in live mode it PATCHes the ACM Hub. Enrollment alone does not set ai-grid/provisioned. Repeated enrollment is idempotent.

200.description: AI Grid membership saved; provisioning may still be in progress

403.description: Backend credentials lack ManagedCluster RBAC permissions

404.description: ManagedCluster or ACM API not found

503.description: Hub configuration, connection, response, or timeout failure

get.summary: Enrolled AI Grid inventory and Thanos metric series

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Set false for inventory-only responses without Thanos queries.

200.description: Inventory with independently reported metric availability

name.description: User-entered group name; existence is not checked.

perToken.description: Decimal string, preserved without numeric conversion.

ModelSubscriptionRef.description: Model identities must be unique within a subscription. tokenRateLimits must contain at least one limit unless unlimited is true; unlimited models require an empty array.

UpdateSubscription.description: Replaces editable fields. Omitted tokenMetadata, inferencePriority and guardrails are preserved; omitted description is cleared. Separate policies are unchanged.

createAuthPolicy.description: Create a matching separate policy atomically. When true, name must be at most 246 characters.

revision.description: Opaque revision; quote it in If-Match.

gpuCount.description: NVIDIA GPU limit per replica; zero omits it.

runtimeArgs.description: Blank lines and comment lines beginning with # are removed. Other lines are joined into VLLM_ADDITIONAL_ARGS.

locations.description: Select one or more values returned by GET /locations.

CreateModel.description: Atomically saves LLMInferenceService, MaaSModelRef, ACM-style Placement and ManifestWorkReplicaSet resources in Git. No cluster requests are made.

revision.description: Opaque revision covers the deployment and associated MaaS registration content.

hasDeployment.description: False for existing catalog entries without a deployment CR.

availableForSubscriptions.description: True when this model has a MaaS registration. Legacy unpublished deployment records remain manageable but are not offered to subscriptions.

locations.description: Locations selected by the model placement. Legacy models without placement return [].

TenantInput.description: Onboard or update a tenant and one OIDC identity provider atomically. The name is immutable on update. Domain names are normalized to lowercase and unique across tenants. No break-glass credentials or raw client secrets are accepted.

domains.description: Domains for tenant discovery; the first is the primary domain. May be empty.

name.description: Existing secret reference name; the API never accepts a client secret value.

domains.description: Domains for tenant discovery; the first is the primary domain. May be empty.

name.description: Existing secret reference name; the API never accepts a client secret value.

status.description: ManagedClusterConditionAvailable True -> Ready; False -> Offline; missing/Unknown -> Unknown.

aiGridEnabled.description: True only when metadata.labels["ai-grid/enabled"] is exactly the string "true".

location.description: ManagedCluster location label, used for model placement.

provisioned.description: True only when metadata.labels["ai-grid/provisioned"] is exactly "true".

metricsSource.description: Demo metrics are generated when Thanos is unconfigured; inventory retains its actual source.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted opaque revision from the resource ETag. Missing: 428; stale: 412. Include the double quotes.
